newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN TAXI DRIVER SHOT DEAD IN BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN TAXI DRIVER SHOT DEAD IN BUDAPEST.

text.p: A 73-year old taxi driver was shot dead shortly after Saturday noon in an outer district of Budapest in what police saw no link with recent wave of attacks in the Hungarian capital.

"Based on circumstances of the attack and data gained from the investigation made on the spot, any link between this crime and recent events in Budapest can definitely be excluded," Hungarian news agency MTI said quoting a police statement.
The police was investigating for an unknown offender, a police spokesman told Reuters. The killed person worked for cab company Fotaxi and drove a Lada car, the statement said.
Fotaxi, which has a 15 percent market share in Budapest, is ahead of its privatisation with a 90 percent stake to be offered in an open tender this month.

The Hungarian capital has been rocked for the past two months by a gangland turf war that has included more than a dozen hand grenade attacks on nightclubs and restaurants and at least three other shootings, one of them fatal.
